inputs.name: registerCodexPickerCommand.codex
inputs.description: The commander Command that receives the picker-mcp and picker-preview subcommands; the function uses it only during the call, by calling its command() method twice. The function performs no check on the value, so the caller must pass a Command from commander.

outputs.name: registerCodexPickerCommand
outputs.description: The function returns nothing; its effect is adding the picker-mcp and picker-preview subcommands to codex. Their action handlers are async and run later, when commander dispatches those subcommands, not during this call.
